title: Felicis leads $7.5M bet on Unsiloed AI to make enterprise documents usable by AI agents
lede: Unsiloed AI turns tables, charts and tangled layouts in enterprise documents into structured data that agents can use, with each value traced to its place in the original page.

points: Its 'dual-stream' vision models handle text tokens and image tokens separately, and heat-map chunking puts more compute on figures, numbers and charts.
A domain-aware decoder tells apart terms that mean different things in different industries.
The startup reports 99.78% accuracy over about 84,000 fields from 542 financial documents; the result has not been independently checked.
In its own olmOCR-Bench runs it scored 88.0, against 66.0 for Reducto's agentic system and 39.9 for Unstructured.
Pricing starts at one cent per page. Customers include an unnamed bank and law firm, and voice AI startup Bolna AI.

sections.text: Agents that read contracts, filings or medical records fail quietly when extraction goes wrong; structured output with source locations lets builders verify each value instead of trusting it.
